text:
leah: Dropping questions from the live all-hands Q&A about promotions / comp / leveling. Will ping people for 1:1s after.

matt: Quick: what's the expected notice for promotion eligibility after a role change? e.g., internal lateral to a new IC path.

erica: Good question. For internal laterals, we treat them as a new role start date. Standard guideline is 9 months in the new role before standard promo consideration, but exceptions allowed with strong impact evidence. Documented in the internal hiring playbook.

nina: Can managers share exact band min/mid/max when discussing potential raises? Some of my reports ask for transparency.

erica: Managers can share the band range for the level and the current midpoint. We ask that conversations focus on growth plan and comp expectations. If anyone needs the exact numeric band DM me and we will share.

matt: Are there any changes to the promotion rubric this year? I remember a calibration note last quarter.

erica: We're updating language to include cross-functional impact and product metrics as explicit evidence. The core pillars (technical ability, ownership, influence, outcomes) are the same. New examples for L3->L4 and L4->L5 will land in the handbook in two weeks.

leah: How does equity refresh factor into promotions? Automatic or case-by-case?

erica: Case-by-case. Promotion itself doesn't guarantee an equity refresh. Managers can recommend a refresh in the nomination form; comp committee evaluates against budget and market. If you feel it's necessary for retention, flag it early.

hr-bot: Reminder: promo nominations for March cycle open 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-14. Use /promo-nom or the promotions form.

nina: One last: is there a clearer timeline for feedback collection? Some promos stall if peer checks take too long.

erica: We ask for peer feedback within 7 business days; managers should nudge. For ad-hoc promotions we can shorten that to 3-5 days if urgency is noted. We'll add a checklist to the promo form to make this explicit.

leah: Thanks everyone. I'll compile a short FAQ doc and link it here. If you want 1:1, ping me or @erica.
